name: Cross-Encoder Conformity Work (doc 22 s4; P2 minimal closed-form coupling probe)
purpose: First reproduce published ANoCo (arXiv:2605.28428, CVPR 2026) as strong training-free baselines on the FROZEN project features (DINOv2-B14 32x32 grid; AnomalyCLIP ViT-L/14@336 image tower bilinearly aligned to the same grid), then test a minimal closed-form CECW coupling. CECW asks whether scoring 'the joint work + cross-encoder correction conflict required to conform to the normal manifold' beats (i) A1 and (ii) the strongest ANoCo single-branch/concat baseline. If the coupling's independent gain over the strongest ANoCo baseline is < +0.003 or a shuffled DINO<->CLIP correspondence does not drop by >=0.003, the route is archived immediately (doc 22 s13).
scope: MPDD development seed0 x shot {1,2,4}, all 6 classes. No BTAD/MVTec tuning; MVTec AD 2 untouched. Evaluator-only Pixel-AP at the frozen STRIDE=8 protocol (56x56 maps) with GT masks used offline only.

features.fusion: A1 concat: per-branch L2 row-normalize, concat(dino*0.5, clip*0.5), faiss.normalize_L2 (common.build_fused_blocks parity)

anoco_baselines.repro_note: ANoCo: per query patch retrieve anchor-consistent normal patches from the ref bank, build a bipartite query->normal graph (no query-query / normal-normal edges), anchored-Laplacian energy E(d)=a||d||^2+2 b^T d, closed-form update d*=-b/a; score = ||d*|| (feature drift magnitude). Ref nodes held fixed. Paper robustness claims flat wrt its Lambda_q ablation -> fixed defaults below, NOT tuned on test.

defaults_pre_registered.affinity: cosine on L2-normalized rows; norm-compat factor alpha=1 because all rows are unit-norm
defaults_pre_registered.edge_positivity: only edges with s_ij > 0 are kept (non-negative Laplacian weights); anchor always included
defaults_pre_registered.neighbor_rule: N(i) = { j in top-M query-sorted refs : cos(f_anchor, f_j) > cos(f_q, f_anchor) } union {anchor}, filtered to s_ij > 0
defaults_pre_registered.update: a_i = D_i + Lambda_q, b_i = D_i*f_q - sum_j s_ij*f_j, d*_i = -b_i/a_i, score_i = ||d*_i||
defaults_pre_registered.fallback: degenerate patch (empty N or a_i<=0) uses the fused A1 1-NN distance for that patch; fallback count recorded

members: fixed-mean (per-image robust01 of ANoCo-DINO and ANoCo-CLIP maps averaged 0.5/0.5) - map-level fusion control

cecw_method.alignment: support-only low-rank orthogonal alignment fit on MATCHED DINO<->CLIP patch pairs of the K reference images (K x 1024 pairs at 32x32): center each branch, cross-cov M = Xc^T Xd, top-r SVD M = U S V^T -> Pc = U_r^T (r x d), Pd = V_r^T (r x d). Pd,Pc rows orthonormal.
cecw_method.energy: min_{dD,dC} aD||dD||^2 + 2 bD^T dD + aC||dC||^2 + 2 bC^T dC + lambda_c ||Pd dD - Pc dC||^2 ; closed-form block solve per patch via Woodbury (r x r), see code; reduces to the two independent ANoCo optima when lambda_c = 0.
cecw_method.score: score_i = sqrt(aD||dD*||^2 + aC||dC*||^2 + lambda_c||Pd dD* - Pc dC*||^2) = sqrt(-E_min); always >= 0. NOT a weighted sum of the two maps.
cecw_method.report_extra: also report ||dD*||, ||dC*|| and the aligned conflict ||Pd dD* - Pc dC*|| maps as diagnostics (not the primary score)
cecw_method.fallback: same A1-distance fallback as baselines; fallback count recorded

controls.ctrl_shuffled_corr: fit Pd,Pc on a fixed-seed random permutation of the DINO<->CLIP support row pairing; coupling solve unchanged. Requires correct - shuffled AP >= 0.003, else the coupling carries no information.
controls.ctrl_no_conflict: lambda_c = 0 joint (independent per-encoder optima), score = sqrt(aD||dD*||^2 + aC||dC*||^2); isolates the conflict term
controls.ctrl_query_query: add intra-image query-query cosine edges and 1 propagation round of the update field over the 32x32 grid before scoring (evidence-dilution control, cf. ANoCo supp S3 message passing)
controls.ctrl_smoothing: ordinary map smoothing control: gaussian_filter(sigma=4) already inside dists2map is the ONLY smoothing; this control applies one extra 3x3 gaussian on the 32x32 score field to show added smoothing is not the source of any gain
controls.ctrl_displacement_only: the two ANoCo displacement maps themselves (ANoCo-DINO, ANoCo-CLIP) and their fixed-mean

gates_per_shot.g0_identity: harness A1 pooled Pixel-AP reproduces the frozen A1 number for the same cache within 1e-4 (monotone-safe sanity, not a method claim)
gates_per_shot.g1_headroom: CECW mean (over 6 categories, pooled per category) Pixel-AP delta vs A1 >= +0.006 AND >= 4/6 categories positive AND worst category >= -0.010
gates_per_shot.g2_coupling_gain: CECW - strongest of {ANoCo-DINO, ANoCo-CLIP, ANoCo-A1concat, fixed-mean} mean delta AP >= +0.003
gates_per_shot.g3_shuffled_drop: (correct-coupling mean delta AP) - (shuffled-coupling mean delta AP) >= 0.003
gates_per_shot.g4_spearman_rescale: if per-patch Spearman(CECW, A1) > 0.98 and |CECW gain| < 0.003 -> judged an equivalent rescale and archived regardless of other gates

decision_rule: Run seed0 shot {1,2,4}. Per shot evaluate g1-g3. ARCHIVE IMMEDIATELY if ANY shot fails g2 or g3 (doc 22 s13 language: coupling gain < 0.003 or shuffled no-drop => archive). g1 must hold on all three shots for a PASS; a shot with g1 mean-delta < 0 also archives. g4 is a global veto. PASS -> deliver audit results only; further scaling (3 seeds) only after doc-22 approval. FAIL -> R0_DECISION.md + FAILURE_ANALYSIS.md and PORTFOLIO_LEDGER update.

leakage.calibration: no test bad / no GT in any fit; alignment and ANoCo retrieval use only reference (support) images
leakage.evaluator: GT masks used offline solely for pooled Pixel-AP / per-category gating
leakage.tuning_ban: no hyper-parameter search on test; all constants fixed above before the run
